Rule.name: managerQuickLink
Rule.Description: Identity Filter Generator rules are used by the Quicklink DynamicScopes to determine the identities that a given user can act on behalf of.

Argument.name: log
Argument.Description: The log object associated with the SailPointContext.

Argument.name: context
Argument.Description: A sailpoint.api.SailPointContext object that can be used to query the database if necessary.

Argument.name: requester
Argument.Description: The identity that is accessing a Quicklink, and for whom the requestable members are being calculated.

Argument.name: filter
Argument.Description: A Filter object that will be used to search for requestable identities.
